sections.heading: TestRunnerMod
sections.title: TestRunnerMod
sections.description: the entry point (`UserMod2`). Reads the command line, sets the crash-reporter flags, adds the assembly resolver that lets test assemblies find the mods under test and this harness, and traces quits.

sections.heading: Session
sections.title: Session
sections.description: command line, state and results of a session.

sections.heading: TestCase and TestResult
sections.title: TestCase and TestResult
sections.description: a discovered test method (id, name, timeout, layer and the attribute flags) and what one test produced (one `results.jsonl` line).

sections.heading: TestBehaviour
sections.title: TestBehaviour
sections.description: a `MonoBehaviour` on the Game object (or on a driver object for a no-colony run). Waits for the HUD, throws the harness switches, finds and clears the fixture area, then runs each test as a hand-stepped coroutine with a real-time deadline, captures logged errors, runs cleanups and writes the result.

sections.heading: Patches
sections.title: Patches
sections.description: Harmony patches, each inert unless `Session.Active`.

sections.heading: Harness
sections.title: Harness
sections.description: the global switches of a run: focus forced on, mouse position locked (parked in the bottom right corner between tests), physical keyboard and mouse ignored, instant build on, speed 1, tool reset, camera look-at.

sections.heading: FixtureArea
sections.title: FixtureArea
sections.description: the 40 by 10 rectangle of the active world that tests build in: fully revealed and buildable, with the most empty cells (cells underground count double). Cleared before the first test and after every test (objects, loose items, solid cells; Duplicants are the test's to remove). `Dupes.Box` walls it for Duplicant tests.

sections.heading: Worldgen and GeneratedWorld
sections.title: Worldgen and GeneratedWorld
sections.description: tests marked `[OniTest(Worldgen = "COORD")]` run in a world freshly generated from that coordinate: the harness goes to the main menu, applies the coordinate, runs the game's worldgen screen, embarks, then runs the test. Consecutive tests with one coordinate share the world. `GeneratedWorld` records the coordinate, the applied coordinate, the cluster, worldgen errors and seconds.

sections.heading: Reflect and Diagnostics
sections.title: Reflect and Diagnostics
sections.description: `Reflect` is the list of private game members the kit and tests use, with `SelfCheck`; `Worldgen.cs` reads two buttons with its own `AccessTools.Field` calls. `Diagnostics` traces the grid marks the game makes during tests (`--onitest-trace=1`).

sections.heading: The kit (`Isochronous.TestKit`)
sections.title: The kit (`Isochronous.TestKit`)
sections.description: what a test author uses.

sections.heading: Invoke-OniTests.ps1
sections.title: Invoke-OniTests.ps1
sections.description: the launcher. For each mod in `-Mods`, finds `src/<Mod>.Tests/<Mod>.Tests.csproj` (in a repo or under `mods/`), builds it, checks the test DLL with `tools/ModCheck`, copies it into the run folder, rewrites `mods.json` so only TestRunner, the mods under test, `-With` and `-Steam` are enabled, launches the game through Steam (or hands the run to a live game), waits for the status, prints a line per test and exits with its code.

sections.heading: Watch-OniGame.ps1
sections.title: Watch-OniGame.ps1
sections.description: the warden of a live session, started detached next to the game. Waits for the game to exit, restores `mods.json` from the backup, removes the live-session folder; ends a game that stops answering.

documents.title: StringsTemplate domain
documents.description: StringsTemplate's Program.Main and its helpers in Program.cs (Entry, Collect, WritePot, CheckOptionKeys, CheckPo, ReadPo and the parameter and link checks), the files it reads and writes, its business rules, terms and code paths

sections.heading: Program.Main
sections.title: Program.Main
sections.description: Entry point. Validates the three arguments, installs the `AssemblyResolve` handler, loads the DLL, finds the top-level `ModStrings` type, collects the entries, writes the `.pot`, runs the option-key check and the po checks, prints the verdict and returns the exit code (0, 1 or 2).

sections.heading: Entry
sections.title: Entry
sections.description: One translatable string: its key (`STRINGS.A.B.C`) and the English text of the `LocString`.

sections.heading: Collect
sections.title: Collect
sections.description: Walks a type's public static `LocString` fields and its nested types, building keys from the names.

sections.heading: WritePot
sections.title: WritePot
sections.description: Writes the template: a gettext header, then per entry a `#. <key>` comment, `msgctxt` (the key), `msgid` (the English, with quotes and newlines escaped) and an empty `msgstr`. Overwrites the file every run, UTF-8 without a BOM, LF line ends.

sections.heading: CheckOptionKeys
sections.title: CheckOptionKeys
sections.description: Finds `OptionAttribute` and `ConfigFileAttribute` (PLib) on every type, property and field of the mod by attribute type name, and fails any `Title`, `Tooltip` or `Category` that starts with `STRINGS.` and is not in the entry list.

sections.heading: CheckPo, ReadPo, Parameter, Quoted
sections.title: CheckPo, ReadPo, Parameter, Quoted
sections.description: `CheckPo` reads a po with `ReadPo` (msgctxt to (msgid, msgstr), parsed the way the game's reader does) and compares it to the entries, counting missing, empty, stale, refused and obsolete ones. `Parameter` joins a keyword line with the quoted continuation lines under it; `Quoted` strips the quotes and throws `FormatException` for a line the game's reader would throw on.

sections.heading: SameParameters, LinkCount, LinksMatch
sections.title: SameParameters, LinkCount, LinksMatch
sections.description: The game's acceptance rules for a translated string: the set of distinct `{...}` tokens equals the English set; the `<link=` count does not exceed the English count; every `<link=` has a `</link>`.
